string.name: perm_internet_reason
string.value: Send chat requests to the model service you configured yourself

string.name: perm_file_persist_reason
string.value: Read the on-device model file you picked, and keep reading it after a restart

string.name: perm_microphone_reason
string.value: Record your voice and analyse it on this device; the recording never leaves it

string.name: chat_need_model
string.value: No model available yet. Add a service key in Settings first.

string.name: chat_empty_reply
string.value: The model returned nothing. Try another model, or again later.

string.name: chat_disclaimer
string.value: YoAI is an AI and can be wrong. Verify what matters.

string.name: chat_empty_title
string.value: Your AI, running on your own device

string.name: chat_empty_body
string.value: Conversations stay on this device. Models are called with your own API key.

string.name: settings_intro
string.value: One key per service, held in this device's encrypted store. Never uploaded.

string.name: settings_model_hint
string.value: The model name to send in the request

string.name: settings_key_saved
string.value: A key is saved for this service

string.name: settings_key_keep
string.value: Leave blank to keep the saved key

string.name: settings_local_intro
string.value: Pick a GGUF file to run on this device, with no network. The file stays where it is -- nothing is copied into the app, and removing a model here never deletes it.

string.name: settings_local_unavailable
string.value: This build has no on-device engine (run examples/harmony/build llama first).

string.name: settings_local_failed
string.value: That file could not be read -- try another one

string.name: settings_need_all
string.value: Base URL, model and key are all required.

string.name: settings_clear_history_msg
string.value: Every conversation on this device will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

string.name: settings_palette_note
string.value: Family and light/dark are separate: pick the family here, the mode above. Each chip shows the palette those two currently add up to.

string.name: settings_text_size_note
string.value: Applies to conversation text; the interface itself keeps its size.

string.name: settings_text_sample
string.value: Rewrite this so it reads more plainly.

string.name: settings_language_note
string.value: Interface only. Existing conversations are left as they are, and the model answers in whatever language you ask in.

string.name: settings_language_partial
string.value: Only Chinese and English are complete; the rest fall back for now.

string.name: settings_prompt_intro
string.value: Sent with every turn, to say who the assistant is, how it speaks and what it avoids. Applies to every model, on this device or remote. Leave it empty to send none.

string.name: settings_prompt_hint
string.value: For example: You are a concise, direct assistant.

string.name: settings_prompt_default
string.value: This is the built-in default, and it changes with app updates.

string.name: settings_tts_intro
string.value: Qwen3-TTS reads replies aloud on this device, without the network. It needs two GGUFs: a talker that writes audio codes, and the 12 Hz tokenizer that turns them into samples. It loads by itself once both are in place.

string.name: settings_tts_unavailable
string.value: This build has no speech output. Rebuild with python examples/harmony/build.py qtts.

string.name: settings_tts_mode_note
string.value: A cloned voice follows a reference recording, which can be your own. A built-in speaker is one of the model's own voices, which sound better today and can be given a reading style. Each uses its own talker model, and switching reloads the voice.

string.name: settings_tts_setup
string.value: These model files are still missing:

string.name: settings_tts_setup_note_app
string.value: If you have them, select them all at once; each goes where its name says. If not, download them into the app's own storage: files already there are not fetched again, and the voice loads when they are done. They are deleted with the app.

string.name: settings_tts_setup_note_folder
string.value: If you have them, select them all at once; each goes where its name says. If not, pick a folder to download them into: files already there are not fetched again, and the voice loads when they are done. The files stay where they are; the app never moves or deletes them.

string.name: settings_tts_pick_both
string.value: Loads by itself once both model files are in place.

string.name: settings_tts_test_text
string.value: Hello, I am YoAI. This voice is made on this device.

string.name: settings_tts_phone_note
string.value: When synthesis is slower than playback (on a phone the 1.7B model takes about three times as long as the speech), a reply is synthesized first and then played in one piece.

string.name: settings_tts_speaker_note
string.value: The model's own speakers, listed once it is loaded.

string.name: settings_tts_style_note
string.value: A short instruction sent with each reading; it applies from the next one.

string.name: settings_tts_seed_note
string.value: 101 by default, chosen for its rhythm. A fixed seed reads the same text the same way every time; another seed changes the delivery. -1 draws a new one every time.

string.name: settings_tts_temperature_note
string.value: %s by default (the model's own is 0.9). Higher varies pace and pitch more and sounds less read out; too high drops or misreads words. Applies from the next reading.

string.name: settings_tts_temperature_custom_note
string.value: A built-in speaker always reads at the model's own 0.9; higher sounded less natural than a cloned voice. This setting applies to cloned voices only.

string.name: settings_reader_ref_note
string.value: The list holds the voices that come with the app, 01_female by default; the .spk for the model's size is chosen when it loads. You can also record your own voice, or choose a .wav recording (mono, 16-bit, 24 kHz) or a .spk vector. A recording is extracted once, in a few seconds, and read from a cache after that; a .spk must match the model's size (2048 values for 1.7B, 1024 for 0.6B).

string.name: settings_reader_enabled_note
string.value: On by default: a reply is read as it is written. When off, a message's Read aloud still works.

string.name: settings_reader_min_note
string.value: 0 means the default, 12. It decides how much the language model must write before the voice starts, not how fast the engine is. Higher sounds more natural (30 was preferred to 12); lower speaks sooner.

string.name: download_err_network
string.value: The download failed: the server could not be reached after several retries. Downloading again resumes where it stopped.

string.name: download_err_checksum
string.value: The downloaded file did not match its checksum and was deleted. Download it again.

string.name: download_err_disk
string.value: The download location could not be written.

string.name: settings_local_offer
string.value: No model on this device yet. You can download this one:

string.name: settings_local_offer_note_app
string.value: Qwen3.5 2B at 4 bits, twice as fast as the 4B. It goes into the app's own storage and is deleted with the app. When done it is added to the list, and selected and loaded if no other model is. To use a GGUF you already have, choose it below.

string.name: settings_local_offer_note_folder
string.value: Qwen3.5 2B at 4 bits, twice as fast as the 4B. Pick a folder to download it into; it is not fetched again if it is already there. When done it is added to the list, and selected and loaded if no other model is. To use a GGUF you already have, choose it below.

string.name: record_script
string.value: The weather is nice today, so I plan to take a walk by the lake this afternoon. The view there is lovely, with flowers in spring and birds in autumn. If you are free too, we could go together, stop at a small cafe for tea, and talk about how things have been. On the way back, remind me to buy some fruit.

string.name: record_note
string.value: Read the passage above in your everyday voice, about 20 seconds. Somewhere quiet, with the phone a hand's width from your mouth. Play the take back before choosing Use this take.

string.name: record_denied
string.value: No permission to use the microphone.

string.name: record_no_mic
string.value: The microphone could not be opened.

string.name: record_too_short
string.value: Too short: record at least 10 seconds.

string.name: record_clipped
string.value: The take is clipped. Move a little further from the microphone and record again.
